generation_rules: Invocation of sacred figures by name
Use of respectful and admiring epithets
Calling and responding between chanter and named entities
pause_rules: Not explicitly described; pauses likely occur naturally between phrases and during call-and-response exchanges.
original_extraction.psychological_function: Induces focused attention and trance-like states via repetitive vocalizations and rhythmic clapping, fostering feelings of humility, reverence, and interpersonal connection.
repetition_rules: Repetition of phrases emphasizing saints and saintesses
Continuous rhythmic clapping accompanying vocal repetition
original_extraction.therapeutic_function: Facilitates spiritual connection and supplication through chanting, rhythmic clapping, and invocation of sacred figures, potentially promoting emotional release and communal bonding.
voice_rules: Use of humming and clapping in rhythmic patterns
Uttering of meaningless syllables ('so', 'si') to maintain rhythm and trance
Drawing out tones to extend vocalization
